drhp.business: PhysicsWallah offers test preparation courses for competitive examinations (such as JEE, NEET, UPSC, GATE and other government examinations) and other courses such as upskilling. Delivery is through online channels (social media, website and apps), tech-enabled offline centers ('Vidyapeeth') and hybrid two-teacher centers ('Pathshala'). As at June 30, 2025 it offered courses across 13 Education Categories via 303 Total Offline Centers, monetising a large free YouTube/social-media community into free and paid users.

drhp.expansion: PhysicsWallah plans to strategically expand its offline presence by opening new PW Vidyapeeth (offline), PW Pathshala (hybrid) and PW Other Centers, using data insights from its online community and a hyperlocal city-level hub approach. financial_valuation.evidence: Restated loss INR 1,270.09M (Q1 FY26), INR 2,432.58M (FY25), INR 11,311.30M (FY24), INR 840.75M (FY23); Net Worth (8,617.89)M FY24; EBITDA (212.21)M Q1 FY26 and (8,293.46)M FY24; FY24 loss included CCPS fair-value loss INR 7,564.66M
financial_valuation.title: Restated losses, negative net worth and negative EBITDA

financial_valuation.detail: Subsidiaries Xylem, Knowledge Planet and Utkarsh Classes incurred losses and had negative net worth, and continued support could affect consolidated financials.
financial_valuation.evidence: Xylem net worth (1,036.03)M Q1 FY26, comprehensive loss (529.50)M FY25; Knowledge Planet net worth (442.00)M Q1 FY26; INR 265.00M to be used for additional 12.25% in Utkarsh; INR 316.48M investment in Xylem
financial_valuation.title: Loss-making subsidiaries with negative net worth

financial_valuation.detail: Default by third parties (payment gateways, B2B customers) on receivables could adversely affect working capital and cash flows.
financial_valuation.evidence: Trade receivables INR 415.39M FY25, INR 428.40M Q1 FY26; credit period 0 to 180 days
financial_valuation.title: Inability to collect receivables / third-party defaults

financial_valuation.detail: Counterparty non-performance has required expected-credit-loss provisions and may increase them.
financial_valuation.evidence: Provision for ECL INR 42.09M (FY25), INR 33.08M (FY24), INR 14.48M (FY23), INR 51.46M (Q1 FY26), INR 37.49M (Q1 FY25)
financial_valuation.title: Provision for expected credit loss on receivables

financial_valuation.detail: Investments in an NBFC that lends to students expose the company to delayed repayment/non-recovery risk.
financial_valuation.evidence: Investments in preference shares and debentures of LKFSL; subsidiary Finz Finance received RBI NBFC registration in September 2025
financial_valuation.title: Investment in NBFC (Lord Krishna Financial Services)

financial_valuation.detail: Contingent liabilities (tax claims) could adversely affect financial condition if they materialize.

financial_valuation.title: Contingent liabilities

internal_operational.detail: Success depends on attracting and retaining students, and rising dropouts/refunds could adversely impact business and financials.
internal_operational.evidence: Number of student dropouts 46,019 in FY25 (7,993 in FY23; 33,769 in Q1 FY26); refunds to dropouts INR 261.45 million FY25 and INR 153.49 million Q1 FY26; dropouts 1.03% of paid users FY25
internal_operational.title: Ability to attract and retain students

internal_operational.detail: The business depends on retaining faculty, and high faculty attrition or inability to hire replacements could disrupt course delivery.
internal_operational.evidence: Faculty attrition rate (employee) 40.40% FY24, 26.98% FY25, 30.00% Q1 FY26; total faculty 6,267 (Q1 FY26); professional fees INR 2,170.29 million FY25; 11 GATE faculty left in Jan 2024
internal_operational.title: Ability to attract and retain faculty

internal_operational.detail: Business depends on continued leadership of founder-promoters Alakh Pandey and Prateek Boob and key employees, whose departure could adversely affect the business.
internal_operational.evidence: Employee attrition rate 45.27% FY24, 36.51% FY25, 37.72% Q1 FY26; employees 15,775 FY25; one employee filed labour-department complaint alleging wrongful termination practices
internal_operational.title: Dependence on founders and key management

internal_operational.detail: Must keep curriculum and content current with changing exam formats/syllabi, and failure to update in time could raise costs and reduce enrolments.
internal_operational.evidence: In Oct 2024 NTA reduced questions in a JEE Main 2025 section; in Nov 2023 NTA removed certain chapters from JEE Main syllabus, requiring content updates
internal_operational.title: Ability to provide updated/relevant content

internal_operational.detail: A significant portion of offline revenue comes from a few cities, exposing the company to concentration risk.
internal_operational.evidence: 303 Total Offline Centers across 152 cities as at June 30, 2025; Delhi NCR 11.24%, Patna 9.45% of offline revenue FY25; Kota enrolments fell from 27,158 (FY23) to 11,540 (FY25); Calicut offline revenue fell from INR 341.36M to INR 240.17M
internal_operational.title: Geographic concentration of offline centers

internal_operational.detail: The PhysicsWallah brand is critical; negative media/social-media publicity or failure to maintain the brand could materially harm reputation and operations.
internal_operational.evidence: Advertisement and publicity expenses INR 2,762.32 million (9.57% of revenue) FY25, INR 1,178.53 million Q1 FY26; instances of teacher-conduct videos going viral in 2023-2024
internal_operational.title: Brand dependence and negative publicity

strategy_growth.detail: Enrolments are concentrated in a few Education Categories; failure to sustain these or grow others could hurt operations.
strategy_growth.evidence: Q1 FY26 online transacting users: NEET 26.64%, JEE 15.63%, Other government exams 12.33%, Foundation 17.61%; NEET transacting users 560,289 (Q1 FY26)
strategy_growth.title: Category concentration in NEET/JEE/Government/Foundation

strategy_growth.detail: Exact locations for new offline centers are not identified and no definitive arrangements exist, with costs based on vendor quotations/estimates.
strategy_growth.evidence: INR 4,605.51 million of Net Proceeds for company centers plus INR 316.48 million invested in Xylem for New Xylem Centers; costs based on vendor quotations/management estimates
strategy_growth.title: Undefined locations / no definitive arrangements for Net Proceeds

strategy_growth.detail: Under six years of operating history, especially in offline/hybrid channels and integrating acquisitions, makes long-term trends hard to predict.
strategy_growth.evidence: Incorporated June 6, 2020; acquired Penpencil, PrepOnline, Utkarsh, iNeuron, Knowledge Planet, Xylem; FY25 offline revenue INR 13,518.70M (46.83%)
strategy_growth.title: Limited operating history and rapid growth

strategy_growth.detail: Reliance on inorganic growth carries risks in identifying targets, integrating them and managing liabilities/compliance.
strategy_growth.evidence: Acquisitions include Xylem 64.98%, Utkarsh 63.25%, Knowledge Planet 100%, PrepOnline/Penpencil/iNeuron 100%; Xylem Kerala premises pending fire NOC; iNeuron Sections 42/62 non-compliance
strategy_growth.title: Strategic acquisitions and integration risk

strategy_growth.detail: Proposed opening of new offline centers is subject to unanticipated delays and cost overruns.
strategy_growth.evidence: Risks include labour shortages, equipment/manpower cost increases, regulatory restrictions and approval delays
strategy_growth.title: Expansion delays and cost overruns

strategy_growth.detail: Significant expansion into offline channels increases setup, manpower and location-related risks.
strategy_growth.evidence: INR 5,140.72 million of Net Proceeds for company offline/hybrid centers plus INR 368.50 million for New Xylem Centers
strategy_growth.title: Increased risks from offline channel expansion
